activity.notes: ATLAS begins Tughril Beg's central Great Seljuk sovereign phase in 1040, following the victory at Dandanaqan and the emergence of the Great Seljuk state, and ends it at his death in 1063. This avoids retrojecting the later imperial polity onto the earlier pre-state family migrations.
